name: comp-446
blurb: Breadcrumb with ellipsis dropdown for collapsed items.
description: Breadcrumb navigation with ellipsis dropdown that expands to show hidden breadcrumb items.
use_when: Long breadcrumb trails that need to collapse hidden levels into a dropdown.
avoid_when: Short breadcrumb paths that fit on one line.
a11y: Semantic breadcrumb with dropdown for hidden items; full keyboard accessible.
